implementation_design_text:
# M03/M08/M09/M11 registered implementation proposal

Preparation only. Nine exact units: M03, M03.COHORT_SMT, M03.PRICE_CVD, M08, M08.MULTISCALE, M09, M09.RECOVERY, M11, M11.MEMORY_DECAY. Each retains P0–P7 separately. The current C01/L01 initial implementation and its review findings remain frozen. No candidate import, compilation, test, fit, market scan or benchmark has run for this batch.

Owned implementation files after registration: extend measurements/structure.py and measurements/quotes.py without replacing their literal comparators; new measurements/divergence.py and measurements/memory.py. Independent reference: references/structure_pressure_memory_literal.py. Tests: tests/test_structure_pressure_memory.py. The shared common.py capture and CVD/cohort APIs belong to Feynman; profile/anchor APIs belong to Mill. No independent tape, histogram or object registry is introduced.

## Shared authenticity and acyclic ports

All new production measurements bind actual validated input recipes and immutable outputs, not caller-created certificate strings. Raw channels remain available when a derived channel lacks support. Times distinguish event, strategy availability, observation cut and actual publication. Corrections create subsequent versions and preserve already published results.

`M08.swing_snapshot`: actual F09 certified time-bar publications or common captured trade window -> causal swing snapshot. `M03.divergence`: M08 snapshot + M01/M02 authenticated CVD results and prewindow fitted scales -> divergence facts. `M09.quote_pressure`: decoded MBP source event recipes -> actual BookReducer transitions -> authenticated quote-window summary. `M10.quote_origin`: M09 quote capture and validated summary -> initial/terminal midpoint and depth/spread changes. `M11.memory`: common captured trade windows, optionally authenticated M04/M05 profile support, and preceding immutable memories -> historical-effort memory. `M11.matured_markout`: memory birth plus subsequently available observed price capture -> separately typed label. `M11.retrieval`: query observable context plus strictly preceding matured episodes -> empirical comparable-episode summary. No current C/G/R forecast feeds an upstream M producer; no markout is a current birth feature.

All iterable public inputs are required bounded tuples or inspected against an explicit length limit before copying. Defaults: 4096 input events, 8 MiB recipe bytes, 32 swing scales, 1024 retained swing/cluster versions, 4096 sparse cells, 1024 training rows, 16 fitted basis columns, 128 retrieval neighbors. Exact and one-over limits are goldens. These are engineering bounds, not selected profitable policies. Eviction requires explicit archived predecessor or unavailable repair, never silent deletion. Incremental counters count actual visits, replay, hashes and copied bytes; no constant-time claim for a full recipe validation.

Root's final fitted-boundary clarification is binding: pure ridge/lag/distance-scale kernels do not certify training eligibility. Every learned publication reopens the actual F11 SemanticArtifactStore commit through shared `measurements/measurement_fits.py::admit_measurement_fit(store, commit_ref, node_id, request, *, schema_id, unit, recipe_id, max_training_rows)` and receives the actual verified TemporalFold, retained training ReadManifest rows, payload and request. Each family reconstructs its own kernel from those retained rows and calls `validate_measurement_fit_payload(admission, reconstructed_bytes)` for exact payload equality. Serving/training admission validates transitive OOF closure and completion, not caller fold IDs or copied admission tokens. Shared M-F11-FIT-001 supplies the clean real-store positive/held-out-read/future-fit fixture; this family's MX08 additionally applies an admitted fitted result through each M03/M09/M11 consumer. No production fit consumer accepts detached coefficients merely because their arithmetic matches.

## M08 production services and substantive tree

`capture_swing_bars(*, engine: SharedBarEngine, publication_ids, cut, published_at, definition_version)` resolves each ID through actual `window_publication`; rejects activity bars, forged finality, mixed raw instrument/domain/calendar/reset/definition, future publications, overlapping incompatible windows and unsupported high/low. It preserves actual WindowRequest coverage and all source/correction IDs. Latest revisions are selected as-of cut by exact bar identity; no revision changes a previously returned snapshot. No detached CausalBar qualifies. Existing pivot_reference remains the independent legacy comparator.

`SwingDefinition(version, kind, left, right, ties, reversal_ticks, scale_version, scale_known_at, frozen_at, max_age_ns)` supports source fixed-bar pivot variants (`strict`, `earliest`, `latest`, `ambiguous` equality) and directional-change variants with exact tick thresholds. A volatility-normalized threshold uses an actual preceding certified price/bar capture and a frozen scale recipe (e.g. mean true range), not a caller-declared positive number. Thresholds are frozen separately at each leg birth; a later scale update affects the next leg only. Changing thresholds alone cannot confirm a reversal. Different source pivot periods/timeframes and fixed/volatility rules have independent definition IDs and are retained as comparisons.

`swing_snapshot(capture, *, definition)` returns confirmed and provisional extrema, raw interval geometry, first extreme occurrence, confirmation event/known time, delay, source support, version and supersession. Equal extrema retain the registered tie rule; no choice based on a later reversal. A right-bar pivot becomes usable only at the maximum publication of the complete left/center/right support. Gaps interrupt a leg and prevent an invented cross-gap swing. An incomplete prefix can extend a provisional leg but cannot rewrite a confirmed prior version. Trade-path swings consume actual captured trades, require priced whole events and exact same-time order; high/low-only bars do not fabricate intrabar reversal order.

`multiscale_swing_tree(capture, *, definitions, previous=None)` advances all registered thresholds over one shared causal path. A node carries scale, leg origin/extreme/confirmation, birth-frozen threshold and source IDs. Same-extreme persistence is the number/list of scales confirming that exact source extremum, not a probability or observed lifetime. The parent is the smallest coarser *already observed* enclosing leg by time and direction under a registered tie ordering. When a coarser leg is still provisional, parent status is provisional and known-at is the current publication; later confirmation or merge appends a relation revision. Prominence is the observed excursion divided by the leg's birth threshold; confirmation cost is price movement and elapsed availability delay from extremum. No future enclosing leg is retroactively attached at an earlier cut. Output includes nearest confirmed high/low, normalized retracement, nesting depth, scale persistence and declared unavailable fields.

`SwingBook.advance(capture, definitions)` stages the complete new snapshot and tree, validates all bounds/identity/correction ancestry, and commits atomically. `checkpoint`/`restore` serialize the bounded recipe and replay it against expected instrument/definitions; altered aggregates, missing predecessors and over-limit decoded payload fail closed. A correction produces new descendants; immutable prior snapshots remain available. F10 export uses existing EvidenceVersion/AnchorVersion/ObjectRevision and authenticated snapshot recipe; confirmation cannot predate source publication and birth keys retain stable source origins.

## M03 cases, continuous mismatch and fitted residuals

`divergence_endpoint(*, swings, swing_id, cvd_result, cvd_capture, cvd_view, cohort=None, comparator, trading_date)` validates the M08 and M01/M02 receipts and binds actual price extremum and CVD statistic under a named rule: CVD value at price extremum, same-window CVD high/low, or final-close comparator. These are distinct variants. Price/CVD cannot silently use different reset anchors, dates, aggregation units or cohort definitions. Running-prefix and pivot-confirmed endpoints have distinct identities. An observed-path CVD estimate is not a true signed-path bound when history/sign is incomplete.

`compare_divergence(a,b, *, cut, scales, tolerance_ticks=0)` returns raw price/flow changes, normalized changes, difference of normalized changes, slopes over explicit duration, regular/hidden flags, tie state, anchor age, confirmation delay and sign/history/order uncertainty. High-side regular is price higher/flow lower; high-side hidden is price lower/flow higher; low-side regular is price lower/flow higher; low-side hidden is price higher/flow lower. Equal within declared tolerance yields tie, never an inferred breach. The output is disagreement, not a directional trade instruction. Tiny and large mismatches remain different numbers even if their flags agree.

`compare_reference_breaches(receiver, source, *, references, opportunity, cut, alignment)` compares exact previously declared references over the common actually observed opportunity interval. The F03 named interval/calendar and F07 source support constrain open/closed/stale sources; absent observations never mean failure to breach. Both event order and knowledge order are exported. If either crossing is not observed, its time is unavailable; a complete observed nonbreach is explicit. Lag is source event minus receiver event only under certified order/time uncertainty. Different raw markets require their own units/scales and explicit alignment; same-asset cohort paths require identical underlying print/reset definitions. Shared soft-cohort contributions do not imply independence.

`fit_divergence_residual(rows, *, train_end, available_at, ridge, basis)` fits an exact bounded ridge least-squares descriptive transform using homogeneous validated historical measurements and train-frozen basis columns (intercept, normalized price change, flow change, lag, and registered pairwise interactions). Each row's inputs/publication and any fitted upstream transforms are available within training closure; fold/source IDs retained. `apply_divergence_residual` exports raw observed target, expected target, residual and supported scale. A separately fitted positive residual scale is required for standardization; zero scale yields unavailable standardized value. This implements the compact conditional/cross-lag basis; a temporal neural/process challenger stays explicitly unimplemented until its model/likelihood/OOF recipe exists. Inference definition availability must precede the measured window; no silent daily refit or current outcome normalization.

## M09 decoded quote pressure and recovery

`MBPEventRecipe(fields, address, native, scenario, strategy_received_at, raw_record)` preserves actual F01 decoding inputs. `capture_quote_window(recipes, *, mapping, terms, instrument, start,end,cut,published_at,coverage,definition,initial_recipes=())` calls existing normalize_mbp and BookReducer, verifies explicit F02 raw-instrument mapping/terms and event availability, and bounds bytes/count before decoding. A convenience CanonicalEvent input requires the exact original normalization recipe and equality after decoding; its ID alone is insufficient because the ID excludes some normalized fields. An initial snapshot can establish state but creates no OFI event and no fresh economic quote age. Prewindow healthy standing quote and first in-window quote are distinguished.

The private frozen capture binds full decoded replay, trusted before/after states, fresh/copy/snapshot semantics, source versions, explicit coverage and ordering support. Quote cuts select received observations; provider sequence is used only within its certified stream. Same-time unknown ordering preserves endpoint algebra where possible but masks path interactions/recovery attribution. A quote window never repairs missing trade history. Actual trade execution eligibility follows F05 normalized T action and reported side; no F_LAST filter and no assumed post-trade decrement of the provider's pre-trade quote.

`measure_quote_pressure(capture, *, kernels)` emits each actual quote transition's exact OFI, separated same-price size and price-change terms; raw sum, per-fresh-update mean, per-covered-second rate, depth-normalized OFI using explicit positive preceding displayed depth, queue imbalance, microprice, spread and tick-valued midpoints. Zero/empty side and crossed or missing BBO keep explicit masks; no division by zero. Imbalance persistence is duration-weighted over observed healthy spans, plus update-count agreement as a separate denominator. Unchanged healthy observations provide exposure without pressure; copied snapshots do not create freshness/exposure. Book-only, trade-only, raw and normalized channels remain separately accessible.

`quote_summary(capture)` and `validate_quote_summary(summary,capture)` provide M10 with initial/terminal midpoint in Fraction tick units, spread/depth changes, actual initial quote time and whether strictly prewindow, terminal quote time, source IDs, exact instrument/window/cut/publication and history/order masks. M10 must pass the capture, not detached ticks. Prewindow context cannot come from a later first in-window quote.

`recovery_episodes(capture, *, definition)` partitions each side by uninterrupted standing best price and trusted observation. At constant best price, net displayed nontrade change is Q_end - Q_start + eligible executed_at_that_touch. Unknown-side/off-touch/hidden or incomplete executions give an explicit unavailable exact net or a declared observed lower-bound channel; never guessed gross refill. Returning to the same price after an intervening price change is a new episode. A gross addition/cancel decomposition and queue identity remain unidentifiable. Duplicate source rows count once. Batched net +3 can correspond to +3 additions/0 cancels or +8/−5 and retains that ambiguity.

Episodes carry birth, first observed depletion, minimum observed depth, recovered fraction of the initial observed depletion, first recovery crossing and timing/exposure; a crossing is known only at its actual update. Recovery before the first eligible depletion is not a recovered episode. Zero baseline, incomplete history and unordered batched paths remain masked. Registered simple exponential/box distributed-lag kernels over exact quote OFI and signed trades expose separate lag channels and products; no future convolution. Compact learned lag weights use the same bounded train-only ridge recipe with frozen event/time basis and target schema. A Hawkes or hidden-state claim requires its own positive-intensity/likelihood/stability initialization recipe and is not approximated by calling these kernels Hawkes.

## M11 historical effort, sparse field and retrieval

`MemoryDefinition(version, minimum_size, price_radius_ticks, time_radius_ns, cohort_definition, spatial_grid, spatial_kernel, decay_clock, decay_scale, max_age_ns)` freezes whole-print membership and metric before evaluation. `build_memory(captures, *, views, definition, cut, published_at, previous=None, profile=None)` validates actual common captures, unions overlapping windows by source transaction identity/version, and never counts the same trade twice. Opposite signs and unknown sign are distinct channels even at one price. Hard clusters are connected components under the frozen same-sign price/time metric; exact sorted source IDs establish identity. New bridging prints can merge clusters forward; corrections/expiration can split them forward; each output retains exact member sets and predecessor relations. Old membership and training groups are immutable. Cluster center is observed volume-weighted price, with low/high/support/count/gross/signed/unknown channels and age. Source size/session/cohort alternatives remain independent registered comparators; OHLC-signed pseudo-delta is explicitly a different input definition.

The sparse field uses `sum size * spatial_weight * decay_weight` independently in buy/sell/unknown channels. A normalized finite triangular kernel over a declared tick grid has nonnegative weights summing to one including explicit overflow; zero-support kernel is rejected. Raw mass and decayed mass are both exported. Time half-life uses observed event age at cut; executed-volume half-life counts subsequent eligible whole-print contracts; visit decay consumes authenticated observed exit/re-entry episodes with a frozen hysteresis/time-away rule. Missing chronology masks volume/visit decay, not raw historical mass. Half-life kernel is `2**(-age/scale)` with registered numeric tolerance; box kernel is exact. Large/small scales are separate features. No memory has institutional ownership, trapped inventory, remaining position or guaranteed support attributes.

`observe_memory_visits(memory, *, price_capture, definition)` records first arrival, departure, re-entry, new eligible effort, observed failures and time away from frozen geometry. Flicker inside the band is one visit. New flow is separately accumulated with source IDs and cannot be manufactured by counting the original cluster again. Protection requires a declared later M08 confirmation and is appended at max(actual confirmation availability, publication); a missed prior opportunity is not backdated into eligibility.

`markout(memory, *, future_capture, future_view, horizon_end, observation_definition)` returns pending until the exact frozen deadline is observed and available. Its origin is the birth-frozen weighted center and side (opposite channels have separate targets); terminal signed change and observed favorable/adverse excursions use the explicit actual trade-price process. Coverage/order/unpriced gaps produce unavailable or bounded observed-path fields, not a zero reward. Include the origin baseline in excursions. Labels retain origin, horizon, earliest knowable time, actual publication and source versions. Maturation is independent of later protection. Overlapping horizons retain the same episode/date group; no new independent sample claim.

`retrieve_matured(query, episodes, *, definition, cut)` is a bounded deterministic k-nearest comparison on declared causal observable features (e.g. size, price-distance, age, prebirth volatility/session), with scales frozen on preceding training episodes. Candidate labels must have matured strictly before query formation and be available by cut; exclude the same evidence/episode/date group as registered. Distances, tie ordering, support count, selected source IDs and empirical outcome summaries are returned. No eligible episodes yields an explicit unsupported result. This implements supported context-conditioned retrieval. Learned survival/lifetime or neural embeddings remain separate downstream fitted targets requiring their own chronological validation; retrieval does not invent a lifetime forecast or identity.

## Validation and phase boundary

Every numeric golden is fixed before candidate implementation. The independent reference may share immutable data types but cannot call candidate selection/reduction/tree/fit functions. Compare source literal rules, corrected causal rules and substantive upgrades on identical captures. Suffix removal, future append, source delay, correction, duplicate input, unknown order, gap/closed source, domain/reset mismatch, retained checkpoint repair, malformed restore and capacity atomicity are tested through actual consumer ports. P2/P4 fixture comparisons retain information versus learner capacity and no-component/simple-component/selected two-way controls. P3 fitted empirical calibration, P5 downstream future-path usefulness, P6 complete policy economics and P7 actual future captures remain explicitly pending authorized data; deterministic fidelity never closes them.
common_contract_text:
# M01–M13 shared measurement evidence port (draft; no candidate execution)

Owner: /root/f04_merge_tests. New file: src/trading_research/measurements/common.py. Preserve existing Trade, TradeView, TransactionTapeView, WindowCoverage, CausalBar and M12 ReferencePrice wires.

## Minimal public API

`capture_trade_window(view, *, instrument: str, start: int, end: int, cut: int, published_at: int, definition_version: str, aggregation_unit: str, coverage: WindowCoverage, max_inputs: int = 4096, max_bytes: int = 8388608) -> CapturedTradeWindow`

`validate_trade_window(captured, view) -> None` recomputes the capture against the actual view and requires exact value equality. Consumers using a detached capture must call this at their admission boundary; a caller-supplied hash or dataclass is not certification. Capturing requires exact supported existing TradeLedger or TransactionTapeView, not arbitrary protocol objects returning invented facts. F05 remains preferred; legacy TradeLedger is explicitly labeled provider-domain-unavailable.

`CapturedTradeWindow` is frozen and contains only `window: MeasurementWindow`, `trades: tuple[Trade,...]`. No duplicate tape per cohort. `MeasurementWindow` is frozen with:

- instrument, start, end, cut, published_at, definition_version, aggregation_unit.
- source_kind (`f05_transaction` or `legacy_trade`), source_domains: sorted tuples of actual F05 root-key (provider,dataset,publisher_or_venue,channel,source_session); legacy empty with explicit unavailable status and cannot claim cross-feed source order.
- source_versions: sorted `(root identity, source content version)` tuples from all in-window actual resolved F05 rows, including explicitly ineligible rows (legacy uses trade.id/source_content_version); correction_ids: sorted actual impacted delta/correction identities; contribution_hash: digest of complete selected Trade records (not IDs alone).
- coverage: actual immutable WindowCoverage, coverage_id: its full digest, observed_duration_ns; support_status (`complete`, `partial`, `unobserved`) derived solely from coverage spans and selected source history; history_complete boolean derived from both, never accepted as an independent input.
- eligible_volume, excluded_volume (known F05 ineligible mass; legacy zero), buy_volume, sell_volume, unknown_volume, unpriced_volume, print_count: recomputed exact integers. Signed observed uncertainty remains `signed +/- unknown`; finite true-flow bounds only if history_complete.
- order_exact: recomputed within event-time ties from unique non-null order, separate from history completeness; covered_print_count: counts prints in coverage spans. A trade outside declared observed spans is a support conflict and fails capture, rather than silently counting its volume over unrelated exposure.
- max_inputs, max_bytes: exact admitted bounds. `id` digest covers every field including actual publication, source provenance and bounds.

Time semantics: requested interval is [start,end), usable event prefix is event_at >= start, event_at < end and event_at <= cut (never calculate cut+1 outside the timestamp domain); cut >= start; publication >= cut; every event known_at <= cut and event_at <= cut. Coverage instrument/start/end must exactly match; coverage.known_at <= cut. WindowCoverage already requires span right <= coverage.known_at <= cut; complete window requires its actual complete coverage through end. Quiet complete empty-window history is certified solely by actual coverage, never by vacuous source-row truth. Partial windows carry partial support and no false completion. Quiet but completely covered windows have zero counts/rates and complete history; zero covered duration is unobserved and rates unavailable. Coverage version cannot be reused with inconsistent bytes within a publishing service.

Input bounds: validate finite positive integer bounds and exact admitted view types before any capture materialization. Legacy view checks len(trades)+len(corrections) <= max_inputs and its configured max_events finite; F05 checks len(ledger.deltas) <= max_inputs and its declared max_records/max_bytes finite before asof/changes. The actual ledger already has a bounded tuple/dict representation. Check tuple lengths before copying/sorting; reject over-bound coverage spans/source domains/corrections before building outputs. Bound individual identity strings and serialized output bytes; no arbitrary generators are consumed. These bounds are conservative on total retained source contributions, including outside-window rows, so asof cannot allocate an unbounded hidden history. Exact capacity succeeds, one over fails without mutation.

F05 unresolved condition eligibility fails explicitly before producing an eligible capture; excluded known-ineligible mass and its source versions stay visible. F05 source domain: infer from actual ResolvedTransaction root keys and require one common fully declared domain within each time tie before trusting source order (matches existing TransactionTapeView). Distinct domains remain explicitly listed, with order ambiguity, never fabricated cross-domain ordering. Aggregation-unit mismatch is a hard error even when numeric flow matches. No standalone-trade plus MBP-trade merging at this port: F05 reconciliation must precede it.

Corrections: capture asof(cut) and changes(cut) from actual view; old capture values remain immutable. A replacement moving across an anchor changes the current source versions and affected correction IDs even if numeric sum is unchanged. `validate_trade_window` uses historical cut, so later corrections do not invalidate genuinely old evidence. Restore is recomputation from actual restored source ledger plus exact original request and coverage, then compare receipt; no independent mutable certificate registry required.

F09 shared-bar adapter: `capture_bar_window(engine, publication_version_id, *, view, aggregation_unit, published_at, max_inputs=4096, max_bytes=8388608)` resolves the actual retained time-bar publication and its exact WindowRequest through `SharedBarEngine.window_publication`. It recaptures the actual source and coverage at the bar's frozen cut and validates raw domain, requested start/end, all selected IDs/content versions/corrections and exact summary volume/priced volume/unknown/buy/sell/OHLC where identifiable. Reject forged, future, wrong-definition, wrong-source and activity-bar publications through this time-bar adapter. Activity membership has its separate whole-event adapter. The returned MeasurementWindow adds `source_bar_version` (None for direct trade capture) to its complete identity. Store the engine/publication request only as a private revalidation recipe, excluded from canonical payload; public consumers revalidate through actual retained publication plus source. This adapter is required by M04/M06/M07/M13; no legacy CausalBar is accepted as its own proof.

## Hand cases to register

1. +5,-2,+4 known exact source => buy9,sell2,unknown0,signed7; one second covered => count3/sec and quantity11/sec. Independent dimensions raw ticks/contracts/ns.
2. Same prints after switching aggregation unit or raw instrument => reject; same numeric +7 under another legitimate source version => different receipt identity. Equal data/cut with publication +1ns => different receipt identity.
3. Unknown print size4 plus known+3: observed signed bounds[-1,7]; complete tape finite; partial coverage history false and true signed bounds unavailable. Covered quiet one-second window => zero rate; uncovered window => unavailable rate.
4. Original +5 in anchorA, corrected at cut20 to event in anchorB: cut10 A=5, B=0 preserved; cut20 A=0,B=5, both current impacts recorded. Restored source ledger reproduces each captured prefix exactly.
5. Same timestamp +10,-20,+10 without shared ordering domain => close0, order ambiguous; source domains retained. Same printed numbers with valid unique local order => true H10/L-10.
6. max_inputs exactly retained count and exact output-byte capacity pass; one additional source record / one output byte less fails before consumer mutation. Reject unsized iterables and massive coverage tuple before copying.

This is a design proposal only. Registration, implementation, one whole-M-batch review, one consolidated repair and one shared verification remain in that order. Learned support/alpha/economics/future evidence remain gated.
anchor_contract_text:
# Shared F10 anchor capture for M04–M07/M13 and M12

Pre-registration proposal only; owner /root/f04_batch_review, intended new file `src/trading_research/measurements/anchored.py`. No source, graph, or candidate execution.

`capture_anchor(graph: ObjectGraph, *, anchor_version_id: str, instrument: Instrument, cut: int, published_at: int, definition_version: str, max_evidence: int = 4096, max_bytes: int = 8388608) -> AnchoredCapture`

Frozen result: exact `AnchorVersion`, tuple of exact `EvidenceVersion` in the anchor's declared order, exact raw `Instrument`, input cut, actual publication, wrapper definition, graph registry definition digest, and canonical lineage-closure digest. Its own id covers all fields. Validate exact supported ObjectGraph and bounded instrument/identity/configuration before materialization; reject overlarge evidence tuple before fetching members. Every evidence is purpose MEASUREMENT, support OBSERVED, same exact Instrument, and event/known time <= cut. Anchor confirmed_at/known_at <= cut; published_at >= cut; instrument valid at the capture cut. Use actual `graph.get_version` values, never a caller-constructed AnchorVersion/EvidenceVersion receipt. `graph.lineage_closure((anchor_version_id,), cut)` verifies that the immutable version and all source dependencies were actually published by the frozen cut; graph already bounds closure. Store digest, not a second graph. Wrapper additionally bounds serialized result bytes.

`validate_anchor(captured: AnchoredCapture, graph: ObjectGraph) -> None` performs the identical historical recapture request and exact equality. Later corrections do not alter genuinely historical capture. This certifies exact historical anchor provenance; it does **not** claim that an old anchor remains the current live supported head. Current object status/birth/TTL stays solely with existing F10 `object_asof`, `active_set` and publication support checks. No duplicate graph or local fabricated expiry rule.

Formula-specific membership remains explicit: a consumer must additionally recapture the actual trade window (shared common.py), compare interval/instrument/aggregation units, and bind the required evidence `content_digest` to the full immutable captured source/member descriptor required by that formula. Merely matching IDs, a start/end pair, or generic "certified=True" is insufficient. Anchor formation evidence and trade accumulation evidence can be different; one is not silently substituted for the other. Each formula registers its exact member digest mapping.

F10 AnchorVersion requires start <= end <= confirmed_at <= known_at. Consequently a future-ended planned session range cannot masquerade as a sealed anchor at session open. An early certified/scheduled open can use an actual zero-span anchor at its known event time, or an evidence-only F10 birth. Accumulation interval is separately requested and may remain developing; no fabricated C01 sealed range. For a composite profile, each constituent has its own captured anchor and trade capture; retain declared chronological constituents, reject duplicate anchor versions, deduplicate exact overlapping trade IDs, reject conflicting repeated-ID bytes. Disjoint windows stay disjoint; no fill across their gaps.

Independent public cases: unpublished/future anchor fails closure; wrong evidence purpose or exact instrument fails; changed evidence bytes with same display price changes identity; correction known20 leaves historical cut10 receipt unchanged; latest active object at20 with unrepaired old evidence remains F10 dirty/ineligible; zero-span open anchor at10 admitted at10 while attempted futureend20 at10 cannot satisfy AnchorVersion; graph born_at and TTL unchanged across capture/publication and refresh; same trade in overlapping constituent windows contributes once, same ID with changed content rejected. One-over evidence/byte bound rejects before downstream mutation.
remaining: All initial family implementation then one combined M review/repair/verification
Actual data-dependent P3-P7 evidence remains pending; no whole source/unit closure
